scenario: EnterpriseScenario; Westhaven private bakery to Eastport; Northport start and real initial voyage.
policy: Wait for 8 bread, retain 2, load 6, sell at marginal bid >=25, empty return; local bakery procurement defaults.
comparison: Manual ordinary commands mirror each automatic dockside chain; compare all physical/economic/accounting state after every chain and day. Configuration, route stage, revision and event timestamps differ by command grouping.
inputMeasure: Count actual manual trade, transfer and departure commands after identical setup; one automatic route configuration replaces those prescribed inputs. Day advancement and shared construction/procurement setup excluded.
blockedMeasure: Distinct economic days with a player Wait/Pause decision, including waiting for a batch threshold. Sailing is not blocked; one reason counts once per day.
variants: Restrictive floor=1000; insufficient stock disables the bakery; no liquidity initializes Eastport cash to 0; slower bakery interval=4; stronger Eastport bread demand=2 units every 2 days. Other EnterpriseScenario rules remain unchanged.
